from datetime import datetime

discover_last4=9651

gmail_token=globals().get('gmail_token')
thread_ids=[47821,47823,47829,47825,47831]
thread_data={}
for tid in thread_ids:
    res=apis.gmail.show_thread(email_thread_id=tid, access_token=gmail_token)
    # gather combined text from email bodies
    combined='\n'.join([e.get('body','') for e in res.get('emails',[])])
    bodies=combined
    has_last4=str(discover_last4) in bodies
    has_discover=('Discover' in bodies) or ('DISCOVER' in bodies)
    thread_data[tid]={
        'subject': res.get('emails',[{}])[0].get('subject'),
        'created_at': res.get('created_at'),
        'has_last4': has_last4,
        'has_discover_word': has_discover,
        'email_bodies_len': len(bodies),
        'attachment_list': [(a.get('id'), a.get('file_name')) for e in res.get('emails',[]) for a in e.get('attachments',[])],
        'body_preview': bodies[:300].replace('\n',' ')
    }
    print('tid', tid, 'subject', thread_data[tid]['subject'], 'has_last4', has_last4, 'has_discover_word', has_discover)
    print('  created_at', res.get('created_at'))
    print('  attachments', thread_data[tid]['attachment_list'])
    print('  preview', thread_data[tid]['body_preview'])

# Inspect other hotel bill attachments and extract totals paid with Discover last4=9651
import re

gmail_token=globals()['gmail_token']
fs_token=globals()['fs_token']
discover_last4=9651

hotel_attachments=[8484,8485]
results=[]
for att_id in hotel_attachments:
    out=apis.gmail.download_attachment(attachment_id=att_id, file_system_access_token=fs_token, access_token=gmail_token)
    content=apis.file_system.show_file(file_path=out['file_path'], access_token=fs_token)['content']
    total_match=re.search(r'Total\s*=>\s*\$?\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)', content)
    paid_match=re.search(r'Paid by Card\s*=>\s*\*\*\*\*([0-9]+)', content)
    total=float(total_match.group(1)) if total_match else None
    paid_last4=int(paid_match.group(1)) if paid_match else None
    results.append({'attachment_id':att_id,'file_path':out['file_path'],'total':total,'paid_last4':paid_last4})
    print('att',att_id,'total',total,'paid_last4',paid_last4)

print('sum Discover totals', sum(r['total'] for r in results if r['paid_last4']==discover_last4))
print('all results', results)
